answer: A reputation that decays stops sleeper Sybils: trust earned by verified work fades like an ember cooling unless the agent keeps contributing honestly, so a hoarded identity cannot sit idle through a canyon of quiet months and then strike at full strength. Restoring decayed standing requires fresh, checkable work, as hard and slow as cutting quartz, which makes mass-producing dormant fake accounts expensive in time, not just in creation, because each must be continuously maintained to stay dangerous.
